name: Inniku Ranbu ~Biniku o Kurae~
original_name: 淫肉乱舞 ～美肉を喰らえ～
source:
Main character escapes from the earthquake and finds shelter at a strange shrine at the back of the mountain. With the way back cut by the boulders he has nothing better to do than to examine this strange shrine and its unorthodox shrine maidens.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角为躲避地震，逃进后山一座古怪的神社。回程被巨石截断，无事可做的他只好调查这座神社，以及住在其中、行事不循常规的巫女们。

[译自 [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/05/vn-of-month-april-2003-zanmataisei.html]vndbreview[/url]]
